overview.text: Tom Peters is vice chair of the Santa Monica Community College District Board of Trustees. He was elected in 2022. In his 2022 campaign, he supported Measure SMC, a $375 million bond for facility renovations. In February 2026, he supported layoffs with amendments to spread the impact and said top management should share the sacrifice.
